sources.title: AI-Powered Pac-Man Agent: Reinforcement Learning in Action
sources.snippet: This project showcases the development of an AI agent capable of playing Pac-Man using Deep Q-Networks (DQN). We built an end-to-end DQN agent for Ms. Pac-Man with a custom Gymnasium reward wrapper for pellet bonuses, survival incentives, and motion penalties.
